description: Cancel an order: its state moves to canceled and its stock goes back (reserved units are released). Moves no money. Final - reopen_order, close_order, edit_order and update_shipment all refuse a canceled order. Refused unless the order is unpaid, or fully refunded with nothing shipped - refund a paid order with refund_order first; refused again for an order already canceled. Takes only the order id - there is no reason field; record a reason in the order's notes with update_order_details first. To mark an order done instead, close_order. Returns the order's id and orderNumber.
name: cancel_order
title: Cancel order
